inspiration: Beacon is a six-frame loop at 8 frames per second with an anchor offset and root-motion table (NextX/NextY) that moves the sprite as it cycles. Lamp or waypoint markers can use the same metadata shape.
The spark effect is a bounded additive particle system: capacity 32, lifetime 0.9 to 1.4 seconds, and a short texture. A cheap impact burst that stays inside a fixed budget.
generate_assets.py writes each TGA frame from a pixel function, then checks SHA-256 hashes before baking. Placeholder art can be deterministic and reproducible, and it stays auditable.
The bitmap font is one PNG atlas plus a glyph table (x, y, width, height, advance) per character. A small fixed glyph cell gives a crisp retro UI text.
Stub sprites (ItemStub, CritterStub) make missing content visibly unfinished, so gaps are easy to spot in play.
Effects are text files with a blend declaration at the top and shader sections below, so a designer can read the blend mode without opening the shader.
